artifact_observations.reasoning: The grid pattern on the hook-and-loop tabs lacks realistic micro-texture (individual hooks/loops). It appears as a flat, slightly blurry geometric overlay rather than a physical textile structure, suggesting AI generation smoothing.

The elastic gathering on the left side blends somewhat indistinctly into the main body fold. The shadows defining the ruffles are soft and lack the sharp occlusion boundaries expected from tight elastic tension.

The top edge of the waistband has a slight 'wobble' or irregularity in its curve that doesn't perfectly align with the cylindrical perspective of the diaper body, though this could be due to fabric flexibility.
